title: Roles & Permissions has no new Technician permission
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Roles & Permissions.
custom_steps: 1. Open the Edit page of the built-in Parts Manager role.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page lists the same permissions as before, including 'Settings → App Settings'.
  • There is no Technician permission, setting or card on the role.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “No new permission is introduced.”
  • Key Decisions: “Technician is a toggle on each staff member, in the staff window next to Sales Representative.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Changing a staff member's Technician toggle, and seeing the staff list with its Technician column and notice, are governed by 'Settings → App Settings', the existing permission for Staff.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
